templates.title: PhValheim Server
templates.description: Manages multiple Valheim worlds and synchronized client mods.
templates.note:
Requires Linux x86-64 and Docker Standalone. Deploys stable version 2.62. The admin port stays bound to host loopback; access it through an SSH tunnel (defaults: ssh -N -L 8081:127.0.0.1:8081 user@docker-host, then open http://localhost:8081). Adjust the tunnel destination if you change the admin port.

The default UDP range 25000-25019 provides ten world port pairs. Choose an even start and an odd end; the same range is published on the host and container. Use the setup wizard to configure your Steam API key and DNS. Retain both the stack's named data and backup volumes when updating to preserve worlds, settings, and backups. See the installation guide.
